name: Ultimate Online handoff and play-action library

rig.primary: football_player.fbx (65 mixamorig: bones), retargeted by the game onto player_model_v2 at runtime
rig.native_v2: clips_v2/ = already retargeted onto player_model_v2 (use one folder or the other)
rig.axes: Y up, +z downfield, +x = the player left; 45.2 rig units = player height (24.7 per metre)

conventions.pairs: Every QB clip has a partner RB clip (partner_file, same interaction_id, same length and events). The QB root is the pair frame; the RB travels along pair.rb_path_m.
conventions.ball: One football, owned by the QB until transfer (handoff), toss_release (pitch) or never (fakes); then by the RB from transfer / catch. owner_timeline lists the owner per phase. No ball mesh in the files.
conventions.events: Seconds from the first frame; also in each GLB under animation.extras.events.
conventions.left_side: *_LEFT files are exact mirrors (RB on the QB left, QB opens left).
